title: Zainab ka dil
body:
shaam aaya zainab ka dil ghabraya
bin chadar bibi ne chehra baalon se chupaya
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kisne kaha ke karbal mein sadaat ke qaime jalte hai
aulaad e umayya ne logon quran jalaya
zainab ka dil ghabraya
shaam aaya zainab ka dil...
<<DIVIDER>>
makhdooma e aalam ki beti ye soch ke nauha karti hai
pardes mein ummat ne haye ye din bhi dikhaya
zainab ka dil ghabraya
shaam aaya zainab ka dil...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghairat ka khuda khoon rota hai maa behne phupi hai be-chadar
chadar ka sawali abid ko ummat ne banaya
zainab ka dil ghabraya
shaam aaya zainab ka dil...
<<DIVIDER>>
kulsoom aur zainab ko ghazi sar nange bhala dekhe kaise
sar noke sina se ghazi ka jab khaakh pe aaya
zainab ka dil ghabraya
shaam aaya zainab ka dil...
<<DIVIDER>>
zanjeer hilaate hai zaalim durre bhi lagate hai zaalim
sone nahi dete abid ko faryaad khudaya
zainab ka dil ghabraya
shaam aaya zainab ka dil...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadqe ke khajooron se jis dam saadat ka isteqbal hua
jab shaam ke rehne walon ne bazaar sajaya
zainab ka dil ghabraya
shaam aaya zainab ka dil...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai safdar o mazhar nauha kuna ek ek masayeb padte huwe
saydaniyan sab thi beparda aur des paraya
zainab ka dil ghabraya
shaam aaya zainab ka dil...
author: Mazhar Abidi
